source_pins.label: the plane has exactly FIVE durable families — the record log, the projection checkpoint, cancellation-fanout plans, archive segments and archive-bound snapshots. A sixth namespace would be a sixth thing to converge that no pinned test covers, and the population would still read green
each of the five families crosses as its own event-stream operation kind, so a family cannot be persisted by borrowing another's crossing

the precedent store's write path is never CALLED here. `265ee73b8` wrote plain daemon JSON projections through persist_record/read_record_dir, which never cross Agentgres, so a crash between 'the route said yes' and 'the truth is durable' was invisible. This pin is the absence, measured — counting admission call sites instead would pin a number that moves whenever a test is added, and would say nothing about the path that must not return

the GoalRun binding stays bounded: composing this owner transfers no Session, launch, thread or HarnessInvocation truth, and no other object owner is implied to be wired here (ADR 0034 sub-ruling 1, INV-35)
source_pins.pattern: does not transfer Session, launch, thread, HarnessInvocation, or other kernel

rule: M04.6's done-bar. `npm run check:m4-work-lifecycle-plane --workspace=@ioi/hypervisor-app` already drives the isolated plane end to end; what it could not give was a FAIL-EMPTY pin over the module's own repair and convergence tests, because a raw filtered `cargo test` exits 0 when its filter selects nothing, so a renamed or deleted module reads as green. Both halves of the plane are pinned rather than only the routes: the module header says every mechanic — content commitment, exact-head CAS, object-scoped idempotency, chain reconstruction, the rebuildable projection, cancellation planning and archive/snapshot/resume continuity — lives in the kernel core, so pinning only the I/O half would leave the tests that actually prove convergence unpinned. ACC-5 clause 7's repair and convergence members are named here explicitly: `idempotent_replay_repairs_a_missing_projection_checkpoint`, `compaction_repairs_a_missing_snapshot_after_a_persisted_archive`, `compaction_then_resume_equals_full_replay`, `replaying_an_old_record_keeps_the_latest_projection_at_the_current_head`, `resume_plus_tail_equals_full_replay` and `chain_reconstructs_from_unordered_storage`. The live half is COMPOSED rather than cited: `check:m4-work-lifecycle-plane` runs as this population's supplementary, so one command answers both halves of the module doc's bar. NOT claimed: the per-dimension reservation/allocation transaction, which is M04.10's, and which no test here covers.

supplementary.label: the live GoalRun journey on an isolated plane (check:m4-work-lifecycle-plane) — the module doc requires this check to COMPOSE it with the fail-empty matrix, not to stand beside it: a name-pinned population proves the tests still exist and pass, and proves nothing about the plane answering over a real daemon
